title: GAUSS Code Execution Result
description: A structured result object for the future gauss_code_execution tool (see tools/gauss_code_execution.md and planning/v0.24.0-gauss-code-execution-prototype.md). This schema validates code execution results only. It does not validate GAUSS syntax generality, statistical validity, methodology, maintainability, documentation quality, education quality, or product value. A schema-valid object confirms structure only; it is not evidence that GAUSS code actually ran, ran safely, or produced meaningful output. Code execution should use the selected GAUSS environment from environment detection (schemas/gauss_environment_check.schema.json) and may use context from package inspection (schemas/gauss_package_inspection.schema.json) rather than re-detecting GAUSS or packages itself.

checked.description: True means an execution attempt was evaluated, not that GAUSS code actually ran.

executed.description: True only when GAUSS was actually invoked as a subprocess. Never true based on intent, request validity, or a successful pre-flight check alone.

executable_path.description: Selected GAUSS executable path used for this execution attempt; null if unavailable or unknown.

gauss_version.description: GAUSS version associated with the selected executable; null if unknown or unavailable.

working_directory.description: The safe working directory execution was scoped to; null if execution did not proceed far enough to have one.

command.description: The literal command/invocation used, if execution was attempted; null otherwise. Should avoid exposing unnecessary sensitive path information.

script_path.description: Path to the executed script file when code_source is script_path; null otherwise.

timeout_seconds.description: The timeout enforced for this execution attempt; null if execution did not proceed far enough to have one.

elapsed_seconds.description: Measured wall-clock duration of the execution attempt; null when GAUSS was never invoked.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when GAUSS was invoked; null otherwise. 0 does not imply statistical validity or correctness.

stdout.description: Captured standard output, possibly truncated; null when not captured or not applicable. Truncation must be recorded in warnings.

stderr.description: Captured standard error, possibly truncated; null when not captured or not applicable. Truncation must be recorded in warnings.

output_files.description: Generated output files discovered inside the safe working directory only.

raw_execution_details.description: Optional implementation-specific diagnostic detail. Should avoid exposing unnecessary sensitive path or environment information beyond what is needed to explain the execution result.

path.description: Path to the discovered output file. Must resolve inside the safe working directory.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes; null when unknown.

file_type.description: MIME type or extension-derived type hint, when safely available; null when unknown.

created_by_execution.description: Whether this file was newly created by this execution attempt, as opposed to already present in the working directory. "unknown" when no reliable before/after comparison was made.
